title: Orange glazed bacon and potato hash

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, bacon, eggs, spring onions, oranges, honey and watercress are all ordinary kitchen and garden foods.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a lidded frying pan and a small pan, with simple frying.

works.reason: Small potato cubes fried for 15 minutes, then crisped bacon and eggs steamed under a lid, give a sound breakfast for four that a cook can follow.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes to cube the potatoes, slice the onions, juice one orange and peel two more is believable, and the cook steps add up to roughly the printed 20 minutes.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: The oranges are a spoonful of honey glaze on the bacon plus sliced fruit on the side, so the hero is a garnish to a bacon and potato hash rather than the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps read plainly in British English and a beginner could follow them.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potatoes, bacon, eggs, watercress and fresh orange make a filling breakfast of real food that a family would enjoy.
